title: THE AMPLITUDE'S MASS-ORDERING PREDICTION: a_c(M500) as a prediction -- band, group-scale cross-check, cosmic closure
context: G122 (the mass-ordering of the free-dust amplitude: rho -0.59, p 0.045, q = -0.41, the registered 12 amplitudes at p* = +0.99); G125 (the group sample -- committed, single-value T, no radial profiles); G098 (per-cluster f_dust medians, floor A); G079 (the cosmic budget, Tinker F(>M) table, closure band); G115 (the warm-floor correction: honest re-closure 0.60-0.79).

basis.a_c: the per-cluster normalization of R = [2x/(x-1)] * a_c * (r/R500)^-p, p* = +0.99 (G122 closed-form candidate, 12 registered log10 a_c values)
basis.q_reg: G122's 96-bin 3-param fit log10 c_dust = const + q log10(M500/8e14) + p log10(r/R500), q = -0.4144, p = +0.9904, rms 0.1189 dex
basis.f_dust: G098 floor-A median f_dust on [0.2, 1] R500, sample median 0.674; f_dust ~ a_c/x-class reading
basis.cosmic_weight: G079's committed Tinker+08 F(>M200) table (1e10-1e15) interpolated in log M; <(M/8e14)^q> mass-weighted
basis.closure: G079's numerator halo(>1e10) + deep(1e6-1e10) + floor (<1e6) over the free-dust remainder; G115's damped band

data_notes: all inputs from the committed deepseek_push/*/results.json registers + the committed Ettori+19 JSON; the F(>M) table is on M200 while the a_c run is on M500 (offset ~0.1-0.15 dex, <= 5% on the weights, noted); nothing written outside deepseek_push/.

checks.name: P0 [reproduction] Spearman(amp, M500) reproduced from the registered arrays
checks.reading: the mass-ordering the prediction rests on

checks.name: P1 [the prediction stated] a_c(M500) runs as M500^-0.41 with the band from the fit error
C1 [group-scale cross-check executable?] the committed G125 sample allows the per-group a_c extraction
checks.measured: NO: 45/60 groups have a single-value T only; 0 radial T(r)/R(x) curves
checks.reading: the cross-check is NOT runnable on the committed record -- the data needed are stated below

checks.name: C2 [in-sample fraction check] the f_dust medians correlate with the amplitude in the direction a_c implies (positive rho)
checks.reading: the fraction runs with the amplitude at cluster scale; G098's committed medians are THEMSELVES mass-ordered in the predicted direction (rho -0.580, p 0.048 -- large clusters carry LESS dust per unit mass), while G123's geometric window-mean reading was flat (rho -0.32, p 0.31): the mass-ordering is visible at the normalization/median level, not (yet) in the G123 window-mean

checks.name: C3 [the cosmic weight] the mass-function-weighted run over the cluster+group window is consistent with a rising dust content at low mass (r > 1)
checks.reading: the a_c(M500) run up-weights the low-mass halos that dominate the mass function

checks.name: V1 [the prediction stated with its band]
checks.measured: THE PREDICTION: log10 a_c = -0.145 + (-0.414 +- 0.157) log10(M500/8e14) -- a_c(M500) = 0.72 (M500/8e14)^-0.41.  At 1e14: a_c = 1.70 (2.37x the pivot); at 1e13 (the group scale): a_c = 4.4 (6.1x the pivot, ratio band x[0.50, 1.99] at 1-sigma q).  The q band: cluster-level OLS -0.414 +- 0.157, bootstrap 16-84 [-0.544, -0.263], LOO span [-0.475, -0.338], pooled-96-bin (naive) +- 0.089.  Spearman(amp, M500) = -0.587, p = 0.045 (n = 12).

checks.name: V2 [the cosmic-weighted f_dust from the a_c(M500) run]
checks.measured: THE COSMIC-WEIGHTED f_dust FROM THE a_c(M500) RUN: over M200 > 1e14 (clusters): <f_dust> = 1.028 (raw linear; band 0.869-1.230; capped 0.894); over M200 > 1e13 (clusters+groups): <f_dust> = 2.102 (raw linear; band 1.329-3.421; capped 0.963); over M200 > 1e10 (all halos): <f_dust> = 12.721 (raw linear; capped 0.985 -- the fraction saturates at 1 below ~3e14: f_dust = 1 at M_sat = 3.09e+14, band 1.73e+14-4.01e+14).  The closure band [0.79-0.95] (G115 damped 0.59-0.63) becomes, with the run over clusters+groups, [1.02, 1.20] (capped-fraction reading) -- OVER 1.0 at the top: the run, extrapolated, overshoots the budget unless it saturates below ~3e14.

checks.name: V3 [the honest statement]
checks.measured: HONEST: the amplitude's mass-ordering is a REGISTERED, marginal pattern (Spearman -0.59, p = 0.045, n = 12; q = -0.41 +- 0.16, LOO stable over [-0.48, -0.34], bootstrap P(q>0) = 0.02) -- a NEW TESTABLE RELATION linking the cluster-side amplitude to the cosmic budget, NOT a closure mechanism: (i) it does NOT fill the 0.60-0.79 deficit -- that deficit is the sub-1e6 warm-floor mass-FUNCTION cut (G115), untouched by a per-halo amplitude run; (ii) extrapolated down, the run OVERSHOOTS the budget (closure > 1 with the cluster-scale f_dark ~ 6-10 normalization held) and must saturate -- f_dust = 1 (the whole missing mass dust) at M_sat ~ 3.1e+14 Msun, i.e. the power-law fraction cannot extend below ~3e14; (iii) the 12-cluster caveat is real: p = 0.045 is marginal and the two no-a0-crossing clusters (A1644, A2255) were flagged off the ordering in G122; the in-sample FRACTION readings disagree on the strength of the mass-run -- G098's committed [0.2, 1] R500 medians ARE anti-correlated with M500 (rho -0.58, p 0.05) while G123's geometric window-mean construction was FLAT (rho -0.32, p 0.31): the mass-ordering lives at the normalization/window-median level, and its window-integrated strength depends on the window -- the discriminating test is the group scale: a_c(1e13)/a_c(8e14) = 6.1 against resolved group T(r) profiles (RP07/Sun+09/Lovisari+15-class), which the committed G125 record cannot yet provide.  Verdict: the relation is consistent, quantified, and falsifiable -- the honest label is PREDICTION (with the saturation bound), not closure.
